title: syswonder/robonix
abstract:
Embodied AI Operating System (EAIOS)

Robonix — The Embodied AI Operating System A system substrate for building embodied intelligence across heterogeneous robots. ## Robonix Robonix is an operating system for embodied intelligence. It explores how to construct a robot's "brain" at the system level: a common substrate on which models can perceive, understand, plan, and act through heterogeneous robot bodies without being rewritten around every vendor SDK. Robonix treats AI models and skills as programs and exposes robot hardware as discoverable capabilities. This separation lets robot developers integrate a body once, while model and skill developers build against shared interfaces for cameras, lidar, chassis, arms, mapping, navigation, speech, and other capabilities. The long-term goal is simple: **train once, deploy on any robot**. > [!WARNING] > Robonix is in early development. abstract_zh: 具身智能操作系统（EAIOS）Robonix——一个用于在异构机器人上构建具身智能的系统底座。Robonix 是一个面向具身智能的操作系统，它探索如何在系统层面构建机器人的“大脑”：一个通用底座，模型可以在其上通过异构机器人本体进行感知、理解、规划和行动，而无需针对每个厂商的 SDK 重写。Robonix 将 AI 模型和技能视为程序，并将机器人硬件暴露为可发现的能力。这种分离使得机器人开发者可以一次集成一个本体，而模型和技能开发者则可以针对相机、激光雷达、底盘、机械臂、建图、导航、语音等能力的共享接口进行开发。长期目标很简单：一次训练，任意机器人部署。警告：Robonix 处于早期开发阶段，API 和内部设计在版本发布前可能发生变化。支持的机器人包括 AgileX Ranger Mini v3、DEEP Robotics Lite3、WHEELTEC R550 mini_tank 和 Unitree Go2 等。
tldr_zh: Robonix 是一个具身智能操作系统，旨在实现一次训练、任意机器人部署。
cover_zh: 机器人“大脑”通用底座？一次训练，任意机器人部署！

judge.reason: 面向异构机器人的具身AI操作系统，提供统一接口，支持多机器人，有实际部署，具系统级参考价值。
